data.narrative:
Terrahaptix, a Series A defense and security company founded by Nathan Nwachukwu and Maxwell Maduka, has raised $34M to date. Valuation analysis draws on a peer set of 10 comparable companies—2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private, including Stark Defence, Singularity, NODA AI, Anduril Industries, and Helsing—all operating in the same sector and stage.

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier to the $34M raised proxy, implying a $68M valuation. Peer-median analysis across three same-sector, same-stage comparables (Stark Defence at $4.0B, Singularity at $400M, and NODA AI at $125M) yields a median valuation of $400M, with a range of $125M to $4.0B. The wide peer dispersion reflects meaningful heterogeneity in investor conviction and technology maturity within the defense sector at this stage.

Triangulation across both methods supports a range of $58M (low) to $460M (high), with a median of $234M. The stage-progression approach anchors conservatively near the raised capital; peer-median reflects market pricing but exhibits extreme outlier variance. Key uncertainties include Terrahaptix's positioning relative to high-outlier peers like Stark Defence versus lower-quartile comps like NODA AI, differentiation in technology or customer traction, and recent funding environment conditions in defense tech. Additional diligence on revenue, customer concentration, and technical defensibility would narrow this range materially.
